shortBio.en: Pulp frontman; class-detail lyrics and spoken-sung delivery on Different Class–era sides.
shortBio.zh: Pulp 主唱；《Different Class》时期的阶级细节歌词与说唱式咬字。

body.en: Born 1963, Sheffield. Lead vocals and principal lyric for Pulp. Different Class (1995) puts the Sheffield character sketches on UK charts.
body.zh: 1963 年生于谢菲尔德。Pulp 主唱与主要作词。《Different Class》（1995）把谢菲尔德人物素描送上英国榜。
